## Goal
- Build and deploy IVX IA as a **fully owner-controlled AI engineering platform** that can operate, code, test, commit, deploy, monitor, and recover WITHOUT Rork — execute end-to-end, not return only a plan; remove all Rork dependencies from the normal development path; verify and sync all credentials live; **rebuild IVX Owner AI as a REAL senior developer that never reports false completion**

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- Owner demands honest senior-developer audit — NOT narrative claims; wants real end-to-end proof
- Owner demands Senior Developer answer format: structured TASK ID / STATUS / FILES CHANGED / COMMANDS / TESTS / DEPLOYED proof — NOT product-support summaries
- **Owner's 16-PHASE MANDATE (2026-07-20): rebuild IVX Owner AI as a real senior developer** — (1) 17-state task execution state machine, (2) 11 task-type classification, (3) 18-step senior-developer loop, (4) fix chat loading defect (7 areas A-G), (5) audit likely files, (6) fix false completion reporting, (7) 7-section narrative, (8) context pipeline with retrieval, (9) permanent system prompt rules, (10) separate execution from response, (11) 22-field structured execution record, (12) prevent duplicate worker reports, (13) 15 chat acceptance tests, (14) 6 IVX response tests, (15) 22-item required proof, (16) 16-section final response format
- **Owner's 16-SECTION CERTIFICATION MANDATE (2026-07-20, second session)**: fresh production QA certification of IVX IA Chat — freeze/identify production, confirm Rork owner-gated policy, chat routing QA (5 request types), one-message-one-job idempotency, authoritative job state, real autonomous coding test, live self-repair, checkpoint/restart recovery, chat UI QA, timeout/heartbeat, permission/safety, GitHub/commit QA, deployment QA, module regression, automated tests, senior-developer certification gates; "Fix every failure found, deploy approved fixes, and return reproducible proof"
- **CRITICAL**: DEPLOYED means only that a deployment occurred; VERIFIED means acceptance tests passed; a CODE_FIX/UI_FIX/FEATURE task with no code change is NOT complete — must return DEPLOYED_ONLY or NOT_COMPLETED, never DEPLOYED
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use `node:zlib` `gzipSync`; pass `.toString('base64')` gzip string as `content`; **use repo-root relative paths (e.g. `backend/services/...`) NOT `/home/user/rork-app/` prefix**
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- APK upload: owner-gated `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` → returns `status:"ok"` + `uploadUrl` + `publicUrl` → PUT APK to S3 → verify via HEAD; do NOT send `Content-MD5` header; use new filename per version
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h; sandbox resets may wipe `/tmp/owner_at`; **re-minted this session after expiry**)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Owner-AI POST requires `{"message": "..."}` field (NOT `"prompt"`)
- Dedup: resubmiting same prompt to `/api/ivx/owner-ai` returns existing job — use unique runId in prompt
- Worker job status endpoint returns nested `job` key: `d.get('job')` NOT top-level; result at `job.get('result')`
- Worker cancel endpoint: `POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs/{taskId}/cancel` with Authorization header
- Per-owner single-flight: only one active task per owner at a time — 3D/3E probes attached to the stuck 3C task (correct behavior)
- `bun test backend/` = 1698 tests / 0 fail (6190 expects); new 16-phase module tests = 86 pass / 0 fail (170 expects); chat merge tests = 18 pass / 0 fail (310 expects)
- Scoped typecheck: `bun x tsc --noEmit` — clean (exit 0) after `bun install`
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or timeout — do NOT loop-poll with sleeps
- Gradle build exceeds 60s — use `setsid` detached background process + poll log; ~4-5 min build time
- Clean sandbox has NO `node_modules` — must run `bun install` in BOTH `/home/user/rork-app` AND `/home/user/rork-app/expo` before gradle build or tsc
- Watchman must be disabled before gradle build: `mv /usr/local/bin/watchman /usr/local/bin/watchman.disabled`
- Mipmaps + splashscreen_logo.png wiped on sandbox reset — regen via ffmpeg from `expo/assets/images/icon.png` + `adaptive-icon.png` + `splash-icon.png` before gradle build
- GITHUB_TOKEN provided by owner via secure requestEnvs box; private env — NOT visible in sandbox bash
- Cannot query Supabase directly from sandbox — no SUPABASE env vars in sandbox
- Messages endpoint: correct endpoints are `/messages`, `/api/messages`, `/api/public/messages` (in `backend/hono.ts` lines 4457-4460 and `backend/express-chat-server.ts` lines 531-534)
- Runtime variables API: `GET /api/ivx/runtime-variables` (presence report), `POST /api/ivx/runtime-variables/verify` (run probes, optional `{name}` for single), `POST /api/ivx/runtime-variables/save` (write new value to Render env), `GET /api/ivx/runtime-variables/audit` (cross-scope audit)

## Progress
### Done
- **19-PHASE RORK REMOVAL — ALL 9 TODO TASKS COMPLETED** (prior session): independence report all 4 phases achieved; `currentPhase: final_removal`, `nextPhase: null`

- **FULL LIVE VERIFICATION BATTERY PASSED** (prior session): 3-way SHA parity ✅; Health endpoints 6/6=200; Auth guard ✅; Enterprise modules 8/8=200; Tests 1608 pass/0 fail; Typecheck exit 0; APK v1.4.24(56) LIVE at CloudFront ✅

- **ALL 16 CREDENTIALS SYNCED AND VERIFIED** (prior session): 10 VERIFIED via live HTTP probe; 6 PRESENT_IN_RUNTIME with functional proof; 0 unauthorized, 0 missing

- **SUPABASE ANON VERIFICATION FIX — COMPLETE, DEPLOYED, LIVE VERIFIED** (prior session): Root cause: probe hitting root `/rest/v1/?apikey=KEY` which always 401s for anon; fix: hit real RLS-enabled table `/rest/v1/jv_deals?select=id&limit=1`; commits `3c7c3d83` + `52a73e5c` ✅

- **FACTORY ENGINE BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, AND PROVEN LIVE** (prior sessions): `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory.ts` — 7 operation kinds; 33 regression tests; commits `e1deca44`+`04f54652`+`8fa36ef0`+`1f628490`+`56a3d061`

- **REAL FACTORY RUNNERS MODULE + WORKER WIRING** (prior sessions): `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory-runners.ts` — real migration/dependency/build runners; wired into worker

- **COMPLETION VALIDATOR BUILT, TESTED, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, WIRED INTO ANSWER-FORMAT** (prior session + this session):
  - `backend/services/ivx-completion-validator.ts` — 11 task types, verdicts VERIFIED/DEPLOYED_ONLY/NOT_COMPLETED/BLOCKED/FAILED/NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED
  - `backend/services/ivx-completion-validator.test.ts` — tests covering all task types and verdicts
  - `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-answer-format.ts` — rewired to use validator; DEPLOYED_ONLY for redeploy with no code change
  - Extended this session: added 'explain/analyze/understand/why is/why does' to INVESTIGATION classifier in `classifyTaskType()`

- **16-PHASE REBUILD — 7 NEW BACKEND MODULES + 8 TEST FILES + 1 REAL CHAT FIX BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED** (prior session):
  - Phase 1: `backend/services/ivx-task-state-machine.ts` — 17 states, `assertCanTransition()`, `stageToTaskState()`, `terminalStateForNoWork()`, 14 tests
  - Phase 4D: `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatMessageMerge.ts` — stable id tiebreak in `sortByCreatedAtAscending()`, 18 tests
  - Phase 7+10: `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-narrative.ts` — `buildSeniorDeveloperNarrative()`, `detectForbiddenVaguePhrases()`, `detectInventedActions()`, 7 tests
  - Phase 8: `backend/services/ivx-context-pipeline.ts` — `buildContextPipeline()`, `renderContextPipeline()`, 5 tests
  - Phase 9: `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-system-prompt.ts` — `IVX_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_SYSTEM_PROMPT`
  - Phase 11: `backend/services/ivx-execution-record.ts` — 22-field record, 7 tests
  - Phase 12: `backend/services/ivx-duplicate-worker-prevention.ts` — idempotency keys, lease store, evidence fingerprinting, 8 tests
  - Phase 13: `backend/services/ivx-chat-pagination.ts` — cursor-based pagination, 15 tests
  - Phase 14: `backend/services/ivx-response-control.test.ts` — 6 controlled tests

- **ALL 7 MODULES WIRED INTO THE ACTUAL RUNTIME EXECUTION PATH** (prior session):
  - **Phase 1+11+12 wired into worker** (`backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`): imports `assertCanTransition`, `stageToTaskState`, `createExecutionRecord`, `completeExecutionRecord`, `validateExecutionRecord`, `computeIdempotencyKey`, `fingerprintEvidence`, `checkDuplicateEvidence`, `normalizeGoalForRetry`; new `finalizeResultWithStateRecord()` helper enforces state machine on terminal transitions + populates 22-field execution record + fingerprints evidence; wired into all 4 execution branches (read-only, factory, autonomous, developer_executor) before `appendLedger`; `idempotencyKey` computed at job submission; `appendLedger` fingerprints + detects duplicate evidence
  - **Phase 7+10 wired into answer-format** (`backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-answer-format.ts`): imports `buildSeniorDeveloperNarrative`, `detectForbiddenVaguePhrases`, `detectInventedActions`; new `buildNarrativeAppendix()` appends 7-section narrative + honesty guard to both worker and proof result formats; `buildWorkerDeployedProofSection` now includes `taskState` + `evidenceFingerprint`
  - **Phase 8+9 wired into owner-ai** (`backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts`): imports `buildContextPipeline`, `renderContextPipeline`, `buildSystemPrompt as buildSeniorDeveloperSystemPrompt`; system prompt now appends `IVX_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_SYSTEM_PROMPT` for every non-health-probe run; new `buildOwnerAIContextPipelineBlock()` function assembles retrieval-scored context (conversation history, task state, repo, commits, deploy state, logs, source files, owner preferences) truncated to 12000-token budget; wired into `buildPromptText()` so every owner-AI prompt includes the context pipeline block
  - **Phase 4 full chat pagination wired** (`expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx` + `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatService.ts` + new `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatPagination.ts`): new Expo-side pagination module with `encodeCursor`/`decodeCursor`/`stableMessageOrder`/`deduplicateMessages`/`prependOlderMessages`/`mergeRealtimeMessage`/`isNearBottom`/`batchRealtimeUpdates`/`buildOlderCursor`; `listOlderOwnerMessages()` added to chat service — cursor-based older-messages fetch via Supabase `.lt('created_at', cursor)` + dedup + prepend; chat.tsx `handleMessageListScroll` now detects scroll-to-top (`contentOffset.y < 120`) and calls `listOlderOwnerMessages` with cursor from oldest displayed message, prepends to React Query cache via `setQueryData`, `loadingOlderMessagesRef` prevents concurrent fetches, `hasMoreOlderMessages
